name: Hoshizaki Corporation
summary: Hoshizaki Corporation researches, develops, manufactures, and sells commercial kitchen appliances and equipment in Japan, the United States, Europe, the rest of Asia. It offers ice making, commercial refrigeration and freezing, thawing, cleaning, hygiene management, cooking, bread making, drink service, food service, and freshness management equipment, as well as prefabricated warehouse; and other services, such as equipment and temperature control systems to the food service, retail, hospitality, food and beverages processing, healthcare, and agriculture and fishery industries.
